title: Pointwise finite cohomological dimension of proper direct image
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative torsion ring and $p:Z\to X$ a proper morphism of arbitrary schemes [def-weil-proper-morphism]. At every algebraic-closure geometric point $x$ of $X$ there is a natural number $d_x$ such that $x^*R^qp_*G=0$ for every constant-$A$ module sheaf $G$ and every $q>d_x$. The bounds may depend on $x$. The scheme, morphism, and functor notions used here are those of [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks, def-weil-pbc-direct-image].

proof.text: Base change to the algebraic-closure geometric point. The proper fibre is of finite type over a field and has finite topological dimension.

If its dimension is at most d, the relative torsion direct-image bound makes the higher images zero above 2d. Apply bounded-below proper exchange to a sheaf in degree zero and commute the exact geometric pullback with homology. This is exactly the already-proved attached source theorem.
